d: Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin held their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. The hour-and-20-minute meeting saw all three leaders call for global peace and stability, with Mr. Trump saying the U.S. and China wanted to help end the war in Ukraine. The Hindu’s Diplomatic Affairs Editor, Suhasini Haidar, analyses the key takeaways.
